light_description: Original handmade overdrive from the builder's early catalog, with internally boosted operating voltage and a wide Treble/Bass range.
2026 handmade overdrive with Rich/Crispy character switching and selectable mid/bottom voicing; dynamic response to playing and guitar volume.
2026 drive pedal using a discrete MOSFET/bipolar amplification design, voiced for warm, glossy amp-enhancing overdrive.
2026 hybrid dirt pedal derived from a Rams Head-style fuzz development, offering normal and upper-octave modes and a range from grainy overdrive to heavy fuzz.
Dedicated boost/pre-preamp product with clean and gain-boost functions; retained as builder history but excluded from central dirt inventory.
